P1.2.text: Precision. Performance. Progress. P1.3.text: From our roots as a Montana-based tissue bank to a recognized leader in advanced orthobiologics, Xtant Medical develops a comprehensive biologics portfolio supported by spinal implants systems that work seamlessly with our grafts.

P1.5.text: Xtant Medical, a tissue bank and a developer of orthobiologics and spinal fixation systems. Our integrated capabilities in tissue processing and biologic innovation allow us to provide surgeons with scientifically engineered solutions for a wide range of procedures.

P1.6.text: Xtant is a leading biologics company with 25 years of clinical success, offering a broad range of orthobiologic solutions. Our vertically integrated operations, from donor recovery to distribution, ensure unmatched quality, traceability, and consistency. With state-of-the-art processing and patented, clinically proven technology, Xtant delivers industry-leading biologics you can trust.

P1.7.text: A complementary portfolio of cervical, thoraco-lumbar, and interbody spinal implant systems used in complex, deformity, and degenerative procedures.

P1.8.text: Our cervical, thoracolumbar, and interbody systems are engineered to pair naturally with Xtant biologics, giving surgeons a single, reliable source for biologic and fixation needs without compromising choice or performance.

P1.10.text: Every graft begins with a selfless act of generosity. Each decision we make—from donor screening to final delivery—honors the trust of donors and their families by ensuring the highest standards of safety, quality, and clinical performance.

P1.11.text: Every product reflects the precision, performance, and progress surgeons rely on.

P1.12.text: Headquartered in Montana, we unite the strength of science, the heart of purpose, and the agility of a vertically integrated business.

P1.16.text: Backed by 25 years in biologics, our solutions, including Trivium™ and OsteoFactor™ Pro, combine innovative science with clinical reliability, offering surgeons confidence in every case.

P2.2.text: About Xtant Our Story Headquartered in Montana, Xtant Medical combines the rigor of science with the heart of purpose. We started as a spin-off from Montana State University’s Center for […]

P2.3.text: Headquartered in Montana, Xtant Medical combines the rigor of science with the heart of purpose. We started as a spin-off from Montana State University’s Center for Biofilm Engineering. We evolved into Xtant Medical, where today, we deliver a comprehensive biologics and fixation portfolio while staying true to our roots: honoring donors, serving patients, and innovating for the future. Our biologics are processed in a dedicated, state-of-the-art facility using patented technologies like BacteRinse™ to preserve essential growth factors while ensuring safety and clinical reliability. This focus allows us to honor every donor gift with the highest standards of quality and respect.

P2.4.text: Through an effective Quality System, Xtant Medical prioritizes our commitment to our patients, our donors and donor families.

P2.5.text: We aim to improve the quality of life for our patients by designing, manufacturing and distributing medical devices and human tissues for transplant that are safe, effective and meet the needs of our customers.

P3.2.text: At Xtant Medical, biologics are at the core of our business. Regenerative Biologics Our vertically integrated tissue operations, spanning donor recovery, patented processing, and distribution, allow us to deliver grafts without compromising safety, quality, and clinical performance.

P2.2.text: Integra LifeSciences is a global medical technology leader dedicated to restoring lives. We are advancing transformational care through impactful innovation in neurosurgery and tissue reconstruction, specialized fields that demand exceptional expertise and precision. Our portfolio of highly differentiated gold-standard products and solutions is built on decades of clinical evidence and trusted by healthcare professionals to improve patient outcomes.

P2.3.text: Dr. Richard Caruso founded Integra LifeSciences and the company acquired collagen technology.

P2.4.text: Integra® Dermal Regeneration Template approved by the FDA and is engineered to promote the regeneration of dermal tissue.

P2.5.text: Leveraging its tissue regeneration technology, Integra received FDA clearance of DuraGen® Dural Graft Matrix for use as a dura substitute for the repair of the dura mater.

P2.6.text: NeuraGen® Nerve Guide is FDA cleared and provides a protective environment across nerve discontinuities.

P3.2.text: Integra offers extensive expertise in collagen biomaterials for companies seeking strategic alliances. Our collagen products are manufactured from bovine deep flexor tendon, one of the purest sources of Type 1 collagen available, with biocompatibility and safety demonstrated in over 10 million implants (neurosurgery, plastic and reconstructive surgery and orthopedic surgery). Integra is a recognized and respected industry leader with vast experience in developing innovative regenerative products with a wide array of applications, including dental applications, sports medicine, bone grafting materials, reconstructive wound healing, hemostasis and carrier technologies for drug and protein delivery.

P3.3.text: Integra is compliant with ISO 13485:2016, FDA Quality Systems Regulations and the (EU) 2017/745 Medical Device Regulations.
